issue_time_rule: End/availability time of the latest completed input bin.
availability_assumption: Source observations are assumed available at their recorded timestamps; hourly summaries are available at bin end. Receipt/transport delays are unobserved, not measured as zero.
history_order: Oldest to newest, six adjacent eligible hourly bins, all available by issue time.
label_rule: Eligible DO target at issue+horizon, with eligible DO throughout the future path; all support in the same session and partition. Future-path coverage is retrospective label eligibility, never an input feature.
quality_metadata_role: Retained per historical bin for inspection/gating; excluded from the default numeric feature matrices. Any later feature use must be explicitly versioned or recorded in the experiment.
plateau_flag_role: Diagnostic-only in the upstream audit; full-run flagging can depend on future readings and is excluded from supervised input exports.
learned_transforms: None in preparation. Fit any scaler, learned imputer or feature selector on training only in model development; validation selects choices, calibration/test do not fit point-model transforms.
paired_comparisons: Match issue, partition, session and horizon across configurations. Joint-horizon comparisons use only issues with both horizons; shared labels/windows are dependent.
